title: Authenticator record
purpose: Review one enrolled sign-in factor and, when its owner has lost it, remove it.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: Requires an active account with both Staff and Superuser status. A laboratory admin role, Staff status alone or individual authenticator or email-address model permissions granted to a user or group do not open this page.
The record is read only. Its secret and any recovery codes are never displayed.

items.label: Last used at
items.description: Most recent successful use, or a dash if never used.

items.label: Delete
items.description: Opens the removal confirmation for this one factor. Use it when the owner can no longer use the factor; they then enroll again from their own Two-factor authentication pages.

items.label: Close
items.description: Returns to the authenticator list without changing anything.

items.label: History
items.description: Opens Django administration history for this record. The account’s audit history is separate.

items.label: Home / app / model breadcrumbs
items.description: Return to administration home, the application module or the authenticator list.

items.label: View site
items.description: Header link to the operational application. Log out submits immediate sign-out.

sections.title: Related factors
paragraphs: A user who enrolled an authenticator app normally also has a separate Recovery codes record. Removing one does not remove the other; open and remove each record that should no longer work.
